newsitem.title: UK: UK MMC report supports BG - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: UK MMC report supports BG - newspaper.

text.p: BG Plc is set for a partial victory over gas industry regulator Ofgas following a UK Monopolies and Mergers Commission (MMC) probe into pricing, the Sunday Telegraph reported.

The newspaper said the MMC report, which will be published in the middle of this month, had dashed plans by Ofgas director-general Clare Spottiswoode to enforce a 28 stg cut in the annual average domestic gas bill.
By altering the rate at which BG can depreciate its assets, the reduction is likely to be closer to 22 stg per year, the Sunday Telegraph added.

The MMC inquiry began last October after BG rejected new price proposals from Ofgas. BG said the proposals, which would regulate charges to gas suppliers for pumping gas through BG's pipelines, were too strict.
BG is the renamed rump of British Gas following the demerger of its gas supply arm into a new company four months ago.
